referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The module includes (via extrapolation from 10 kW heat pump) the most important materials used for production. It includes also the transport of these materials, energy and water needed for production. It includes emissions of refrigerant (R134a) during production and scrapping. A buffer heat storage is not included.
